{{recipe}} [[Category:Recipes for sandwiches]]
== Ingredients ==
* 2 cooked [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] tenderloin steaks, sliced thinly
* 6 [[Cookbook:Slicing|slices]] [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|pepper jack]] [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]
* 6 slices [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], crisp cooked
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (1 foot-long) French or Italian loaf, split in half

== Procedure ==
#Build a sandwich with all of the ingredients.
#Toast in a 200°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until cheese is melted and bread is toasted.
